known_but_never_transitioned.reason: Known refs arise from exact analytical product registration with actually consumed determinant authority; initial current selection supplies the accepted baseline. No transition means no lifecycle invalidation of that registered baseline.

new_schema_zero_noncurrent_rows.reason: Positive-only historical compatibility is the exact old field set; the owner emits the new schema only when noncurrent rows exist. New schema plus zero rows is an owner-never-emitted third representation and must fail closed.

shared_owner_law.failure: The rollback fixture pre-registers each product against old_model, v2_ref and v3_ref before future revisions are consumed/current, reintroducing forbidden future-determinant pre-binding.
